headline: Committee amends South Maui Community Plan actions and defers the item

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.summary: The committee voted 8–0 to support a Ridge to Reef group and 7–0 for a tourism impacts plan, then deferred the item. It plans to meet Wednesday morning for more public testimony, starting with Planning Department presentations.
meeting.recap: The committee resumed its review of the South Maui Community Plan.[[0:06:33]] Members voted 8–0 to support a South Maui Ridge to Reef group or similar nonprofit to reduce reef pollution.[[1:45:00]] Members passed a change asking for easy public tracking of approved developments and settlement agreements.[[4:16:28]] Members passed a change for legislation on a South Maui cultural overlay map, a map to protect cultural sites.[[4:50:41]] Members voted 7–0 for a tourism impacts plan that must prioritize Native Hawaiian cultural practices and shoreline access.[[5:48:28]] The committee deferred the item, and its main motion as amended carries over.[[5:52:41]] The committee plans to meet again Wednesday morning and take more public testimony.[[5:53:03]]
decided: Members changed Action 4.19 to support creating a South Maui Ridge to Reef initiative or similar nonprofit to reduce land-based pollution that damages coral reefs.
Action 5.04 on cultural advisor engagement was set aside for a later revisit.
Members changed Action 5.06 on locations for art and cultural events from short to ongoing timing.
Members changed Action 5.09, encouraging the state to do archaeological surveys, from mid to ongoing timing.
Members added federal and private funding sources to Action 5.10 on cultural centers and museums.
Members changed the lead agency for Action 5.12 on signs to the department captioned as OUV resources.
meeting.next: Wednesday's meeting will start with Planning Department presentations, then public testimony, then review of Section 3.

moments.q: Reading of South Maui's draft vision statement
"Please hear me. You've created a death trap."
Council gets its first action item from a community plan advisory committee

boards.name: Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee

issues.oneLine: The committee changed a plan action to support monitoring water quality in all South Maui nearshore waters, focusing on runoff from gulches and streams.
issues.why: The chair said the effects of runoff from major gulches are seen in the nearshore waters.
issues.brief: The Department of Management will lead the monitoring action and can bring in other departments as needed.[[#1]]
